<!-- pr-reviewer: 35b9c03545bb7282f9ce0fe117240c546edbced5 -->

**Needs changes before merge** - one process finding, no code defect.

## What looks good
- The guard in both posts is byte-identical to the reference guard in `assets/posts/tormach.cps`: same regex, same `- ` prefix, same comment. `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps:302-303`, `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps:94-95`.
- The machine-name comment (the reported hole, `tormach-lathe.cps` line 347 and `tormach-plasma.cps` line 128) is now guarded, and user comments via `onComment` are guarded too.
- Pinning tests for machine names that open with active keywords, for user notes, and for inert names (lathe, plasma): `crates/post/tests/tormach_lathe_post.rs`, `crates/post/tests/tormach_plasma_post.rs`.
- Existing golden suites stay green: the change touches only comment text.

## Results (local build, trial merge of origin/main b439de579 into head 35b9c035)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test tormach_lathe_post --test tormach_plasma_post` - 4/4 pass (run locally, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6`, sccache).
- `script_tormach_lathe` 11/11, `script_tormach_plasma` 11/11 (recorded golden suites, no change from this PR).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean.
- No example-catalog case uses the Tormach lathe/plasma posts (catalog cases use the Fanuc/Haas mill posts), so no catalog step is owed. No light-lane twin exists for this code (no `light lane` marker in `crates/post`). The issue is `P7`, so no targeted heavy step is owed.

## Requested before merge
1. Add a one-line reason in the PR body for the two new top-level test files (`crates/post/tests/tormach_lathe_post.rs`, `crates/post/tests/tormach_plasma_post.rs`). AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite": a new top-level file under `crates/*/tests/` needs a one-line reason in the PR body, or it belongs to `ISOLATED`/`SLOW_BINARIES`. Either add the body line, re-home the tests into a directory suite, or add the files to one of those lists.

## Notes
- The decisions doc (`docs/decisions/4231-tormach-comment-active-guard.md`) enumerates a short keyword list (`MSG`, `DEBUG`, `PRINT`, `LOG`, `PROBEOPEN`, `ABORT`, `AXIS`, `PY`) that is shorter than the regex, which also covers `LOGOPEN`, `LOGAPPEND`, `LOGCLOSE`, `PROBECLOSE` and `PYRUN`. Cosmetic - the code is the authority.
- The decision doc heading uses `#` while the README names `##` and lists "what was considered and dropped"; the file covers the same content in substance.
- The regex and the `- ` prefix are exactly those of the reference `tormach.cps` guard and the `comment_escape.rs` expectation, so the guard matches the LinuxCNC active-comment rule as the repo already implements it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
